token.title: 🔑 GitHub token
token.intro: GitHub adireshi token kǝrǝmbaro saa'a falro tambaya 60 amsǝna. Forkbe bǝski kamǝl tambaya 32 dǝgǝ dǝ, kuru ziyara indibelan karewa. Token iyakaga saa'a falro 5000-ro kuradǝ.
token.step1: Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens bǝdǝ, dǝga Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner: accountnyi. Expiration: tarikh ngawo-ngawo, bǝski awo wakti kurawu lardǝba.
token.step4: Izini fal dǝ taɓaba. Ma'ajiya jama'abe metadata izini fal dǝ lardǝba.
token.step5: Sǝdǝ, dǝga {token}be kima kwafidǝ. GitHub fal kǝlkǝl nunana.
token.classic: Token gargajiya dǝ gǝni: izini fal dǝ zabeba sǝdǝ. Izini fanko dǝ bayan jama'abe gudun tabbatarbelan karatuna.
token.stays: Browser adǝlan mabudi {key}be kǝlan ajiyana kuru {host}-ro kǝlkǝl lezǝna. Adireshibe layilan abada rubutǝnaba, kuru link nyi raba gani kawuna, sirri kawunaba. Maballi wuribe ngǝlan cache-a fal shafana.
token.persistHow: Token serverbe {env} fayillan, shafi adǝ ajiyaya, {port} gefelan sǝdǝ:
token.proxy: kuru {make}-a farkodǝ. Dǝga container nginx rabawa rubutǝna, {header} header {path} proxy-ro haɗna, kuru browser tushenzǝro kirana, token abada kǝrǝmba. Wuri adǝ bacena, bakowa samma kasafi fal saa'a falro 5000 rabana.
fork.refused404: Rashewabe layiwa ba: {message}. 404 adǝlan rashe mbejiba, au hanya proxy serverbe kawunaba; forkbe nizam fǝlan kamǝl dǝ.
fork.refusedExhausted: GitHub saa'a adǝlan tambayawa karena, kuru rashewabe layiwa zanadǝro gǝnaba. Forkbe nizam fǝlan kamǝl. Tacebe panellan token karadǝ, au surabe panellan rashewabe layiwa kashǝ, kasafi nizamro kǝlkǝl sǝdǝro.
fork.refusedOther: GitHub commitbe tarihiro {status} amsǝna, kuru rashewabe layiwa zanadǝro gǝnaba. Forkbe nizam fǝlan kamǝl.
fork.tagsOrphaned: Tag tarikh ba, kuru ragowa fal-fal tambaya fal lardǝ, saa'abe kaso ragowa awo adǝro sǝdǝnaba.
fork.axisZoomed: {axis}, commitwa-a tagwa kawudǝnabe taga. Forkbe layiwa adǝga gargajiya gefe kanuribelan tura.
fork.axisWhole: {axis}. Ma'ajiya bǝdǝ, commitbe hanyawa-a haɗǝwanzǝ-a zanadǝro; dǝga layi tarihi adǝro kǝtǝna.
